newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end largely flat,awaiting direction.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end largely flat,awaiting direction.

text.p: Italian shares ended largely flat on Thursday after trading in narrow ranges through a subdued day with the early rise of Wall Street and data showing a continued inflow of money into equity funds having little positive impact.

Stocks showed little inclination to move out off tight trading ranges today and like domestic bonds were awaiting developments to give the market fresh direction. Not even the early rise in U.S. stocks after Wednesday's fall could inspire buyers out into the open, dealers added.
The all-share Mibtel index ended down 0.03 percent at 12,256 and the blue chip Mib30 0.15 percent lower at 18,235.

Data today showed Italian investment funds had a net inflow of 5.709 trillion lire in May with equity funds up 1.176 trillion, but dealers said the overall figures showed a similar rise to April and there was little market reaction.

Among the blue chips, oil giant ENI ended up just 0.01 percent at 8,652 lire it investors awaiting details of the Italian Treasury's offer of a third tranche of its shares, which is expected this weekend.
Fiat added 0.26 percent to 5,735 lire while others such as Pirelli and Olivetti did better, up 0.78 percent at 3,861 lire and 0.83 percent firmer at 485.9 lire respectively.
